roles.source: UEMA_Embodied_Gain_of_Function_Addendum_v4.html section 31; the fields named are the training stats record's (replay_training_stats.jsonl, type mimo) unless marked otherwise
roles.rule: A low loss is not a gain of function. A gain of function is an observed, repeatable, increasingly intentional and generalizable capability. Nothing is removed until a validated controlled measure replaces it and a replay or regression check shows the replacement reads the same events.

roles.note: Whether the machinery runs, not whether anything was learned.
